style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; brilliant autumn daylight, strong raking sun and crisp deep shadows, glowing sky, rich saturated colour; figures small, unidealised, painted in a few strokes. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: establishing, far. A poor street of terraced brick houses in Bethnal Green, London, 1893, on a bright October afternoon: washing lines, children playing on the cobbles, a pump, long shadows; a tall young man of twenty-five with prematurely white hair, in a dark overcoat and bowler hat, seen small from a distance knocking at a low door.

Shot: establishing, far. A small workman's cottage in Walworth, south London, 1893, with a tiny front garden, at late-afternoon teatime in golden low sun; a hansom cab waiting at the kerb; a tall young man of twenty-five with prematurely white hair, in a dark overcoat and bowler hat, seen small from a distance at the gate.

Shot: establishing, far. A narrow London court of old lodging-houses, Potter's Court, in early morning sun, steam rising from a gutter, a man in shirtsleeves at a doorway; a tall young man of twenty-five with prematurely white hair, in a dark overcoat and bowler hat, seen small from a distance looking up at the doors.

Shot: establishing, very wide. The docks at Poplar on the Thames, 1893, at noon in brilliant sunshine: warehouses, cranes, sailing barges with red-brown sails, carts and horses on the quay, crowds of workmen; a tall young man of twenty-five with prematurely white hair, in a dark overcoat and bowler hat, seen small from a distance walking along the quay.

Shot: establishing, far. Sackville Street, Mayfair, 1893, a quiet elegant street of brick and stone houses on a bright autumn afternoon; a brass plate by a black door, a hansom passing; a tall young man of twenty-five with prematurely white hair, in a dark overcoat and bowler hat, seen small from a distance climbing the steps.
Shot: medium-wide, no people. A sunlit hall of a London town house, 1893: on a polished table a silver salver with an opened letter and envelope, morning light from a tall window, flowers in a vase.

Shot: establishing, far. The red-brick asylum at Purfleet, 1893, on a brilliant autumn afternoon, seen across a wide lawn with clipped yews, a gravel walk and a weathered stone statue; tall barred windows on the upper floor catch the sun.

Shot: far, exterior. One barred upper window of the asylum seen from the garden in afternoon sun, a pale figure standing motionless behind the bars, ivy and brick around, a gardener raking leaves below.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. A long whitewashed asylum corridor in afternoon light, sun falling through tall windows in bright bars across the floor, a row of closed cell doors, a doctor in a dark coat walking away small in the distance.

Shot: very wide. The asylum grounds at Purfleet in late afternoon sun: an old walled garden, a stone urn and a statue of a woman on a plinth, fallen leaves, beyond the wall the high dark trees of the neighbouring old house, Carfax.
